name: Agent Tools Fixture
description: A test fixture that gives agents one tool per tier and one skill.

tools.name: echo
tools.title: Echo a message
tools.description: Returns the message it is given. Use it to check the extension answers.

tools.name: bump_counter
tools.title: Add to the counter
tools.description: Adds a number to the extension's counter and returns the new total.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.title: Delete a note
tools.description: Deletes one note by its id. Pretends to: nothing is stored.
